title: A narrative states each figure in the role its input holds, or as a quoted text holds it
assertion: Passes: days, pages, versions, releases, levels, years, counts, units and rows each with their words, in digits, with commas or in words; a quoted figure beside its own words, in the role its quote gives it; at least 100 hand-written forms not drawn from the drafting templates; each figure in the role of the noun after it or its nearest cue (“the $30.00 difference”, “the payer paid the contract rate”, a deadline after “days after payment”), “respectively” in order, its cues before the list or after it, in the scope its words state for the list or with each cue (“$300.00 and $70.00 were expected in total and allowed per line, respectively”, or with each between commas), never a clause of its own after it (opened by “which”, or by “and”, “with” or a participle before words of its own), an opening “For each line” never in a later clause that states its own scope or names the lines together (“..., and the claim was allowed $210.00”) nor in a result (“..., so the payer owes $90.00”), each line’s and the lines’ totals, ordinals and partitives as prose (“the first 3 claims”, “2 of the 3 claims”), “Lines 1–3”, a locked fee schedule’s year and business days to pay; a number with no role fails
